How can I protect my intellectual property rights in my specific invention or creative work?

Example (question + answer, several paragraphs, aligned with the negated text)

How can I protect my intellectual property rights in my specific invention or creative work?

First, I can protect them by documenting what I created and when I created it. I keep dated drafts, notes, or other records that show the development of the invention or work.

Next, I can protect them by controlling how I share the work. I decide who gets access, under what conditions, and I keep the terms consistent when I distribute or present it.

Finally, I can protect them by using formal mechanisms that match the type of work. I choose a protection method appropriate to the invention or creative output, and I keep the relevant records together so the protection is clear and traceable.
